title: Array
description: Divide an array of distinct integers into three non-empty sets such that one set’s product is negative, another’s is positive, and the third’s is zero.
input_format: First line: n (number of elements). Second line: n distinct integers a_i.
output_format: Print three lines—each starts with the size of the set followed by its elements—for sets with product < 0, > 0, and = 0 respectively.
expected_approach: Pick one negative (if any) for the negative-product set, one positive for the positive-product set; place zeroes and remaining numbers appropriately to satisfy the conditions.

test_cases.explanation: One negative, one positive, one zero.
One negative in first set; two negatives (product positive) in second; zero in third.
